description: Durable DEFAULT-PROMOTION proposal queue. The promotion engine (hermes-nous/sffs/promote.py) DETECTS when an A/B test arm clearly beats the current default and writes a `pending` proposal here (arm, metric deltas, sample size, confidence, recommended new default). Proposals are NEVER auto-applied: a human approves/rejects each via `sffs_promote_default --approve <id>` / `--reject <id>`. Every decision is appended to decisions_log (append-only) and, on approval, to ab-testing/content-defaults.json history + learnings.json decisions_log. The autonomous agent can only DETECT/LIST/SHOW (sffs_promote); it can NOT approve.

proposals.rationale: MANUAL belief-driven promotion (owner decision): make the prominent mascot the default so every new video leans into the brand mascot. Mascot view data is still INCONCLUSIVE, so this is belief ahead of proof; the retained mascot-absent A/B control (minority allocation) keeps gathering the counterfactual and this is reversible via the ledger if prominent underperforms.
